product_name: Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist chat can preview the combined code suggestions for changes spanning multiple files.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist chat can preview the combined code suggestions for changes spanning multiple files.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist chat can render referenced workspace filenames as clickable links.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist chat can render referenced workspace filenames as clickable links.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist can show suggested code changes as a diff directly in IntelliJ chat.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist can show suggested code changes as a diff directly in IntelliJ chat.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist can generate multi-part code suggestions in IntelliJ chat and let you accept one change or all changes; VS Code Gemini Code Assist can generate multi-part chat code suggestions that can be accepted individually or all at once.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist can generate multi-part code suggestions in IntelliJ chat and let you accept one change or all changes; VS Code Gemini Code Assist can generate multi-part chat code suggestions that can be accepted individually or all at once.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist agent mode can plan and carry out multi-step coding tasks with user review before changes are applied; Gemini Code Assist chat in IntelliJ can run in agent mode for multi-step tasks with plan review and approvals.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist agent mode can plan and carry out multi-step coding tasks with user review before changes are applied; Gemini Code Assist chat in IntelliJ can run in agent mode for multi-step tasks with plan review and approvals.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist agent mode can automatically approve actions and let you review or roll back afterward.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist agent mode can automatically approve actions and let you review or roll back afterward.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist agent mode lets you edit suggested changes directly in the integrated diff view.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist agent mode lets you edit suggested changes directly in the integrated diff view.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist can display inline diffs in chat for proposed code changes.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist can display inline diffs in chat for proposed code changes.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist can preserve agent mode or interactive chat state between IDE restarts.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist can preserve agent mode or interactive chat state between IDE restarts.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist agent mode can stream shell command output in real time.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist agent mode can stream shell command output in real time.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist for VS Code can show code changes inline in the editor with added and deleted lines highlighted.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist for VS Code can show code changes inline in the editor with added and deleted lines highlighted.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist in IntelliJ can stop an in-progress chat response; Lets you stop an in-progress chat response in VS Code Gemini Code Assist.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist in IntelliJ can stop an in-progress chat response; Lets you stop an in-progress chat response in VS Code Gemini Code Assist.

features.feature_summary: Displays chat code suggestions in a preview block by default in VS Code Gemini Code Assist, with options to show them collapsed or expanded.
features.extended_definition: Displays chat code suggestions in a preview block by default in VS Code Gemini Code Assist, with options to show them collapsed or expanded.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist in VS Code can be configured to use local codebase awareness; IntelliJ Gemini Code Assist can include local project files in chat prompt context.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist in VS Code can be configured to use local codebase awareness; IntelliJ Gemini Code Assist can include local project files in chat prompt context.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist chat suggestions in VS Code can be reverted to a prior checkpoint.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist chat suggestions in VS Code can be reverted to a prior checkpoint.

features.feature_summary: Lets you configure .aiexclude and .gitignore files to exclude files from local context in VS Code Gemini Code Assist.
features.extended_definition: Lets you configure .aiexclude and .gitignore files to exclude files from local context in VS Code Gemini Code Assist.

features.feature_summary: Lets you select and attach code snippets so Gemini can focus on smaller code blocks instead of entire files in VS Code Gemini Code Assist.
features.extended_definition: Lets you select and attach code snippets so Gemini can focus on smaller code blocks instead of entire files in VS Code Gemini Code Assist.

features.feature_summary: Lets you attach terminal output to the chat context so Gemini Code Assist can answer questions about terminal commands and output.
features.extended_definition: Lets you attach terminal output to the chat context so Gemini Code Assist can answer questions about terminal commands and output.

features.feature_summary: Automatically scrolls through chat responses in VS Code Gemini Code Assist for easier reading.
features.extended_definition: Automatically scrolls through chat responses in VS Code Gemini Code Assist for easier reading.

features.feature_summary: Lets you click filenames referenced in a chat response to open the file in the IDE.
features.extended_definition: Lets you click filenames referenced in a chat response to open the file in the IDE.

features.feature_summary: Automatically excludes files in .gitignore from local context across chat, code generation, code completion, and code transformation in VS Code Gemini Code Assist.
features.extended_definition: Automatically excludes files in .gitignore from local context across chat, code generation, code completion, and code transformation in VS Code Gemini Code Assist.

features.feature_summary: Provides a drawer for reviewing and removing files and folders included in Gemini Code Assist prompt context.
features.extended_definition: Provides a drawer for reviewing and removing files and folders included in Gemini Code Assist prompt context.

features.feature_summary: Adds action buttons to chat responses that contain error messages in IntelliJ Gemini Code Assist.
features.extended_definition: Adds action buttons to chat responses that contain error messages in IntelliJ Gemini Code Assist.

features.feature_summary: Lets you create, save, and run preconfigured prompts for repetitive tasks in IntelliJ Gemini Code Assist; VS Code Gemini Code Assist supports custom commands in the inline chat menu and lightbulb menu.
features.extended_definition: Lets you create, save, and run preconfigured prompts for repetitive tasks in IntelliJ Gemini Code Assist; VS Code Gemini Code Assist supports custom commands in the inline chat menu and lightbulb menu.

features.extended_definition: Lets you attach local workspace folders as prompt context in IntelliJ Gemini Code Assist, with support for a 1M-token context window.

features.extended_definition: VS Code Gemini Code Assist can apply user-defined rules to each chat request.

features.extended_definition: VS Code Gemini Code Assist supports creating and managing multiple chats.

features.feature_summary: IntelliJ and VS Code Gemini Code Assist support streamed chat responses; IntelliJ and VS Code Gemini Code Assist support streamed chat responses in public preview.
features.extended_definition: IntelliJ and VS Code Gemini Code Assist support streamed chat responses; IntelliJ and VS Code Gemini Code Assist support streamed chat responses in public preview.

features.feature_summary: Gemini Code Assist chat can provide contextually relevant code suggestions and insights without additional configuration.
features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist chat can provide contextually relevant code suggestions and insights without additional configuration.

features.feature_summary: IntelliJ Gemini Code Assist can show which files are used by chat and let users customize the context.
features.extended_definition: IntelliJ Gemini Code Assist can show which files are used by chat and let users customize the context.

features.extended_definition: Code customization can now use customer-managed encryption keys to encrypt data at rest through Cloud Key Management Service.

features.extended_definition: Gemini Code Assist for IntelliJ now supports code transformation with commands or natural language prompts and a diff view of pending changes.

features.feature_summary: Administrators can automatically or manually assign Gemini Code Assist licenses; Administrators can assign, unassign, and view Gemini Code Assist user licenses through the Google Cloud console or the billingAccounts.orders API.
features.extended_definition: Administrators can automatically or manually assign Gemini Code Assist licenses; Administrators can assign, unassign, and view Gemini Code Assist user licenses through the Google Cloud console or the billingAccounts.orders API.
